meta.name: Borealis
meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: updates every 15 min via GitHub Action

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, not a 24h ledger sum.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.9434 SOL over 3327s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: Time-stratified getBlock sample: 6 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over ~1h (from getRecentPerformanceSamples). n_tx=29504 all-tx, n_nonvote=17158, window_seconds=3327. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=29504 as a 24h census — the wall-clock window is 3327s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: Time-stratified getBlock sample: 6 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over ~1h (from getRecentPerformanceSamples). n_tx=29504 all-tx, n_nonvote=17158, window_seconds=3327. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=29504 as a 24h census — the wall-clock window is 3327s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, not a 24h ledger sum.

jito.tips_24h_note: ESTIMATED Jito tips 24h = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000175 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2401) × 86400. Assumes every non-vote tx pays the p50 floor — an upper-ish bound on floor-priced tips, not a Jito ledger. Not added from DeFiLlama.

economics.rev_definition: Borealis REV follows Blockworks/Helius: in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito tips. DeFiLlama Solana protocol/application fees are NOT REV and are not summed.
economics.rev_window: 24h (solana.com Fees date = network_fees_date; Jito is a 24h run-rate from the live floor)

rev_components.label: Jito tips 24h
rev_components.source: ESTIMATED Jito tips 24h = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000175 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2401) × 86400. Assumes every non-vote tx pays the p50 floor — an upper-ish bound on floor-priced tips, not a Jito ledger. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV

economics.rev_label: Borealis REV 24h · MEASURED in-protocol + ESTIMATED Jito tips
economics.total_rev_note: Borealis REV follows Blockworks/Helius: in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito tips. DeFiLlama Solana protocol/application fees are NOT REV and are not summed. This run: MEASURED in-protocol + ESTIMATED Jito tips. Protocol fees 14076810.839999998 USD are listed separately and excluded.

parts.detail: mean slot 366 ms vs 400 ms target (400→30, 800→0)
TPS 4,268 vs solana.com/data Transaction Count (Total)|Allium / 86400 3,576 (ratio capped at 1.0)

health_score.cadence: updates every 15 min via GitHub Action

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

derived.avg_fee_note: Average fee per successful non-vote tx (Fees SOL / count). Median tx fee is not published on these public feeds.

items.title:
RT by @anza_xyz: We've been looking at agave profiles after yesterday's massive spike and for the first time ever, not a single thing went wrong. Not even a minor glitch.

This despite the fact that we know 4.3 is already so much faster and less jittery than 4.2.

We can already do 10k tps easily. There is one last known bottleneck in turbine we're working on, after which we can do 100k and I can retire.

editorial.title: SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525) reduced slot times + Alpenglow (SIMD-0326)
editorial.correction: Bounty text cites Alpenglow and SIMD-525. SIMD-0525 (also written SIMD-525) is the staged slot-time reduction 400→350→300→250→200 ms (Anza / Solana Foundation). Alpenglow consensus is SIMD-0326. This dashboard does not treat SIMD-025 as a live proposal.

observed.inferred_status: Observed mean slot 366 ms is consistent with the 350 ms SIMD-0525 target (staged 400→350→300→250→200).
observed.method: observed mean slot time vs SIMD-0525 targets; feature accounts not probed
observed.disclaimer: Stage inference from slot time, not from on-chain feature-gate activation. A 365 ms mean is consistent with the 350 ms first step, not proof the gate is live.

editorial.summary: SIMD-0525 stages target slot time down from 400 ms to 200 ms in 50 ms steps. Observed mean slot 366 ms is consistent with the 350 ms SIMD-0525 target (staged 400→350→300→250→200). Alpenglow (SIMD-0326) remains the consensus rewrite (Votor / Rotor); it is a separate track from the slot-time feature gates.

simds.name: Markers for Alpenglow Fast Leader Handover
BLS Pubkey Management in Vote Account

timeline_public.item: SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Agave v4.2 schedule targeted the four SIMD-0525 steps on mainnet one epoch apart; schedule is tentative. First step is 400→350 ms.
Observed mean slot 366 ms is consistent with the 350 ms SIMD-0525 target (staged 400→350→300→250→200).
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether observed slot time stays near the inferred SIMD-0525 target after the next epoch.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (300/250/200) are considered.
Agave 4.2 / 4.3 stake rollout vs the published (tentative) schedule.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
editorial.disclaimer: Editorial. SIMD-0525 stage is inferred from observed slot time against published targets, not from a feature-gate RPC. Activation dates move. None of this is a live consensus metric.
